meta.name: ChefFlow Design System
meta.source: Consolidated from app/globals.css, tailwind.config.ts, lib/themes/color-palettes.ts, lib/ui/contrast-contract.ts and docs/specs/*. This file is the SOURCE OF TRUTH. Run `npm run tokens:build` after editing.
authority: 3. app/globals.css TOKENS block - generated, do not hand-edit
4. tailwind.config.ts - generated scale keys, do not hand-edit inside markers
meta.colorFormat: Colors are stored as space-separated sRGB channels so Tailwind alpha modifiers work: rgb(var(--brand-500) / 0.2)

brand.description: The Copper and Cast Iron identity. Palette-swappable at runtime by lib/themes/color-palettes.ts; these are the default (copper) values. Never hardcode these hex values in components.
brand.scaleNotes: The copper ramp is generated from the six identity swatches, which left two duplicate stops (300==400 and 600==700). The other seven palettes are monotonic. Fixed 2026-09-09: stop 300 is now a true interpolation ('245 209 171') between 200 and 400. Stop 600 is deliberately LEFT pinned to the deep swatch ('177 92 38', identical to 700) because --focus-ring-color in light mode resolves to brand-600 and measures 4.63:1 against surface-0; an interpolated 600 drops that to 3.49:1. Contrast wins over ramp aesthetics.

neutral.description: The warm stone ramp. Deliberately INVERTED in light mode so dark-first utility usage renders correctly on light surfaces. tailwind.config.ts aliases zinc/gray/neutral onto this same scale, so bg-gray-800 and bg-stone-800 are intentionally identical.

surface.description: Five-tier depth. 0 is the page ground, 4 is the highest raised chrome. Inputs, cards and popovers must all sit on this scale - never on a raw stone-* class.

text-placeholder.note: Dark-mode placeholder was stone-500 (120 113 108), which measures 4.12:1 against surface-0 and fails WCAG AA for normal text. Raised to 134 126 120 (4.96:1) on 2026-09-09, still clearly dimmer than --text-muted at 7.83:1. Light mode is unchanged at 6.92:1.

text-inverse.use: text on a filled brand surface

status.description: Status meaning is GLOBAL. success is always emerald, warning always amber, danger always red, info always brand. The silhouette (dot, chip, row accent, icon, text) is local. Never introduce a new hue for an existing status role.

focus-ring-color.note: brand-600 in light mode because brand-500 fails WCAG on near-white

interaction.focus-ring-contrast-light: 4.63:1 against surface-0 (255 252 247) - AA text, well past the 3:1 non-text minimum

overlay.media-scrim-note: The ONLY approved treatment for text over photography. Never a flat colour wash over an image.

display.use: h1 and h2, hero headlines, large metrics, editorial pull quotes
display.rule: The brand voice. Never used below 20px and never for body copy.

sans.stack: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji'
sans.source: tailwind.config.ts fontFamily.sans - system stack, zero network cost
sans.use: everything else: body, labels, nav, buttons, captions, tables
sans.rule: The interface family. No webfont is loaded for it, deliberately.

mono.stack: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
mono.use: code, IDs, tokens, hashes, fixed-width data
mono.rule: Functional only. Never for prose or headings.

scopedExceptions.reason: The culinary board is a deliberate corkboard/handwritten-note surface. The handwriting is the interface metaphor, not decoration.
scopedExceptions.constraints: Must stay inside that route. Must not appear in any shared component. Loading must be scoped to that route, never in the root layout.

sm.use: default UI text, table cells, buttons

weights.reason: The system stack renders 300 and 800 inconsistently across platforms; Playfair is loaded at 400 and 700 only.

typography.maxLineLength: 68ch for long-form prose, 44ch for card body copy

loading.strategy: next/font with display:swap for Playfair. No @font-face and no raw <link> to a font CDN outside the scoped exception above.
loading.fallback: Georgia for display, system sans for body. Both are metric-adjacent enough that swap does not shift layout materially.

rules: Never set font-family inside a component. Use font-display, font-sans or font-mono.
Never load a font family that is not in this file.
Never load a weight that is not in weights.allowed.
Inputs render at max(16px, 0.9375rem) to stop iOS auto-zoom. Never override that down.

space.grid: All spacing is a multiple of 4px. A 2px half-step (Tailwind's .5 steps) is approved ONLY for dense control padding and icon gaps; it is intentional, not debt.
space.banned: Arbitrary spacing values (p-[13px], gap-[2px]). If a value is not on the scale, the layout is wrong, not the scale.

control.note: sm and md share a 44px minimum height because every control is a touch target. They differ in horizontal padding and type size, not height.

icon.note: Phosphor duotone at 20px is the IconContext default. Never mix sizes inside one visual group.

size.containerNotes: max-w-content (72rem) is the shipped app shell width used by components/navigation/chef-main-content.tsx and must keep that exact key name. prose caps long-form reading, form caps single-column forms, settings caps settings panes at 768px per docs/research/settings-ux-visual-scalability-patterns.md.

radius.description: Mirrors Tailwind's own radius values exactly, so the 15,551 existing rounded-* usages are untouched. Only the semantic aliases below are added to the Tailwind theme. Derived from actual usage: rounded-lg (5610), rounded-full (3278), bare rounded (2549), rounded-md (1946), rounded-xl (1529) cover 96% of the codebase.
rules: Focus outlines are square (border-radius 0) per the WCAG guidance already in globals.css.
Never use an arbitrary radius. The eleven values above are the complete set.

elevation.description: Three shadow tiers, not five. Depth is carried mainly by the surface scale; shadow is the secondary cue.

layer.description: The complete stacking contract. Twelve named layer classes were already in use across roughly 180 call sites (z-dialog, z-float, z-fab, z-page-bar, z-mobile-header, z-chrome, z-toast, z-command, z-offline, z-island, z-context-menu, z-system-overlay, z-subnav, z-status, z-fab-secondary, z-spotlight) while NONE of them existed in tailwind.config.ts, so every dialog, popover and floating control stacked by DOM order alone. The vocabulary was recovered rather than replaced: each name that was already being used keeps its name and is given a value.
rules: float (menus, selects, popovers, comboboxes) sits ABOVE dialog on purpose, because a menu opened from inside a modal must render over it.
overlay (50) is the dialog scrim; everything below 50 is page chrome and is therefore covered by a modal. A floating action button must not float over a dialog, which is why fab is 45.
command (74) is above float because the command palette is its own modal surface; spotlight (78) is above command because an onboarding highlight has to sit over whatever it points at.
toast (80) is above every modal surface, so a failure message is never hidden behind the thing that failed.
Never write an arbitrary z-[9999]. Use z-max, and if you need z-max, say why in the pull request.
The pre-existing numeric classes z-10/20/30/40/50 map onto raised/sticky/chrome/nav/overlay and stay valid.
Mobile first. 375px is the design baseline, not an afterthought.
Never read window.innerWidth to branch layout. Import BREAKPOINTS from design-system/tokens/tokens.ts or use a Tailwind prefix.
Container queries (.cq-shell + @container) are preferred over viewport queries for components that appear in both a sidebar and a full-width page.

motion.purpose: Motion explains hierarchy, state, causality or spatial movement. Nothing animates to look richer.
motion.nonEssential: Everything else, including card stagger, dialog enter, scale-in, slide-down, attention pulse, confetti, parallax, Ken Burns, tilt, glow and magnetic effects. All of it is suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion.

reducedMotion.strategy: A global @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block collapses animation and transition durations to 0.01ms, forces animation-fill-mode to forwards so entrance animations resolve to their final state instead of staying at opacity 0, and disables smooth scrolling. The selectors in motion.essentialSelectors are exempt: loading spinners, skeleton shimmer and progress fills keep moving because they are the user's only feedback that work is happening. Authors opt anything else in with class="motion-essential".
reducedMotion.rule: Reduced motion must never leave the interface broken. Entrance animations that start at opacity 0 must resolve to their final state, not stay invisible.

loadingThresholds.over10s: background task with a notification on completion

density.note: Density changes vertical rhythm only. Touch targets never shrink below 44px in either mode.

limits.description: Hard maximums carried over from docs/specs/universal-interface-philosophy.md section 6. These are part of the design system, not separate governance.
limits.topLevelNavItemsNote: The philosophy spec says 7 and the qol skill says 5; docs/chef-navigation-decision-contract.md fixes exactly 6 and is the binding contract, so 6 wins.

a11y.focus: Every interactive element shows a 3px solid focus-ring-color outline at 2px offset on :focus-visible. Fields use 2px at 1px offset. Focus is never removed without a replacement of equal or better visibility.
a11y.states: Every interactive component defines default, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled and, where it can be async, loading and error.
a11y.meaning: Colour is never the only carrier of meaning. Status always pairs colour with an icon or a text label.
a11y.targets: 44x44px minimum on touch, 24x24px minimum for mouse-only, 8px minimum gap between adjacent targets.
